statement.notes: 1) 'cash' field mapped to 'Cash and cash equivalents' only; term deposits and restricted cash not included. 2) 'investment_in_securities' field calculated as sum of 'Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss' and 'Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income' from both current and non-current assets; excludes investments in associates/joint ventures. 3) 'short_term_debt' calculated as sum of current 'Borrowings' and 'Notes payable'. 4) 'long_term_debt' calculated as sum of non-current 'Borrowings' and 'Notes payable'. 5) 'accounts_payable_and_or_other_liabilities' calculated as total liabilities minus total debt (short_term + long_term). 6) 'advance_payments_from_sales' mapped to total 'Deferred revenue' (current + non-current). 7) 'advance_payments_for_purchases' not found in statement. 8) 'inventory' mapped to 'Inventories'. 9) All values in RMB millions as per statement.
